1	/**
2	 * The spill-policy PLUGIN: a `tools/post-execute` result transformer that keeps
3	 * oversized plain-text tool results out of the model's context. When a final
4	 * result's UTF-8 size exceeds `maxInlineBytes`, it saves the FULL text to a
5	 * session-scoped spill artifact (`ctx.spillStore`) and replaces the
6	 * model-facing result with a bounded head/tail preview plus the backend's
7	 * locator and retrieval guidance.
8	 *
9	 * It registers NO service and owns NO storage or preview mechanics: preview is
10	 * `@deepseek-ai/dsh-output-retention` (`TextRetainer`), storage is `ctx.spillStore`.
11	 * The policy only decides WHEN to spill and composes the notice.
12	 *
13	 * A second arm applies the SAME cap to the durable log: the
14	 * `tools/ptc-dispatch-log` waterfall bounds the `tool/code-dispatch` event's
15	 * copy of an oversized `run_code` sub-call result (the program's value is
16	 * untouched; UIs and replay read the full text through the spill artifact).
17	 *
18	 * ## Deliberately narrow
19	 *
20	 * - Omitted `maxInlineBytes` ⇒ the plugin registers nothing (a true no-op).
21	 * - Plain-text results only: a result carrying any non-text block is left
22	 *   untouched (the policy knows only the final formatted text, not tool
23	 *   internals).
24	 * - Nested composite calls skip the MODEL-facing arm; their durable log copy
25	 *   is bounded by the dispatch-log arm instead.
26	 * - Accepted value replacements pass through for registry revalidation and
27	 *   rendering; this presentation policy cannot also replace content in the
28	 *   same mutually exclusive decision.
29	 * - `read` is skipped by the model-facing arm to avoid a
30	 *   `read → spill → read again` loop; the dispatch-log arm bounds `read`
31	 *   sub-calls too (a log copy is not model context, and `read` is precisely
32	 *   the tool that produces huge logs).
33	 * - Best-effort: no session owner, no `ctx.spillStore` backend, or a save
34	 *   failure ⇒ log and return the original result. A spill failure must NEVER
35	 *   turn a successful tool call into an `isError` or hide the inline result.
36	 *
37	 * It COMPOSES with other post-execute listeners: its prepended listener
38	 * delegates via `next()` and bounds the resulting content projection, so
39	 * tool-owned asynchronous projection runs before generic bounding, a hook that
40	 * replaced content still has its replacement bounded, and value replacements
41	 * and `block` decisions pass through unchanged.
42	 *
43	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-spill-policy
44	 */
45	
46	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
47	import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
48	import type { ContentBlock } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
49	import { TextRetainer, describeOmitted } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-output-retention'
50	import type { Omitted } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-output-retention'
51	import type { SaveTextSpill, SpillRef } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-spill'
52	import type { SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
53	import type { ToolCallId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
54	import type { PostToolDecision, ToolExecution } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'
55	import type { SpillPolicyExec } from './types.ts'
56	
57	export type { SpillPolicyExec } from './types.ts'
58	
59	/** Plugin config. */
60	export interface Config {
61	  /**
62	   * The model-facing context cap for a plain-text tool result, in UTF-8 bytes.
63	   * Omitted disables the policy entirely (no-op). When set, a result larger than
64	   * this is spilled and replaced with a preview derived from this same budget.
65	   */
66	  maxInlineBytes?: number
67	}
68	
69	/** Cordis plugin name used by loader diagnostics. */
70	export const name = 'spill-policy'
71	
72	/** Require the tool registry (its `tools/post-execute` waterfall is the extension point we transform). */
73	export const inject = ['tools']
74	
75	export const Config: z<Config> = z.object({
76	  maxInlineBytes: z.number(),
77	})
78	
79	/** All-text content flattened to one UTF-8 string, or `undefined` if any block is non-text. */
80	function flattenPlainText(content: ContentBlock[]): string | undefined {
81	  let text = ''
82	  for (const block of content) {
83	    if (block.type !== 'text') return undefined
84	    text += block.text
85	  }
86	  return text
87	}
88	
89	/** The owning session id, or `undefined` for a call with no agent (a direct/test call). */
90	function ownerSessionId(exec: ToolExecution): SessionId | undefined {
91	  return (exec as SpillPolicyExec).agent?.session.header.id
92	}
93	
94	/** Build the bounded head/tail preview for `text`, splitting `budget` bytes across the two ends. */
95	function preview(text: string, budget: number): { text: string; omitted: Omitted } {
96	  const headBytes = Math.ceil(budget / 2)
97	  const tailBytes = Math.floor(budget / 2)
98	  const retainer = new TextRetainer({ kind: 'headTail', headBytes, tailBytes })
99	  retainer.push(text)
100	  const kept = retainer.finish()
101	  return { text: kept.text, omitted: kept.omittedBytes }
102	}
103	
104	/** The spill-notice line for a given omission + saved reference (no preview, no leading blank line). */
105	function spillNotice(omitted: Omitted, ref: SpillRef): string {
106	  const omission = describeOmitted(omitted, 'bytes')
107	  return `(${omission} Full formatted result stored at: ${ref.locator}. ${ref.retrievalHint})`
108	}
109	
110	export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): void {
111	  const maxInlineBytes = config.maxInlineBytes
112	  // Omitted ⇒ no automatic spill policy: register nothing at all.
113	  if (maxInlineBytes === undefined) return
114	  // Validate at LOAD, not per call: a negative/fractional cap would reach
115	  // TextRetainer's assertBudget and throw, turning every oversized-result call
116	  // into an isError. A bad config must fail the deployment, not the tool.
117	  if (!Number.isInteger(maxInlineBytes) || maxInlineBytes < 0) {
118	    throw new Error(`spill-policy: maxInlineBytes must be a non-negative integer (got ${maxInlineBytes})`)
119	  }
120	  // Narrowed once for the nested arms (closure narrowing does not survive awaits).
121	  const cap: number = maxInlineBytes
122	
123	  /**
124	   * Spill `text` and build the bounded replacement (preview + notice), or
125	   * return `undefined` when the policy must keep the original (no session
126	   * owner, no backend, storage failure, or no within-cap replacement).
127	   * Shared verbatim by the model-facing post-execute arm and the durable
128	   * dispatch-log arm so both produce byte-identical projections.
129	   */
130	  async function spillReplacement(
131	    text: string,
132	    totalBytes: number,
133	    sessionId: SessionId | undefined,
134	    toolName: string,
135	    callId: ToolCallId,
136	    label: 'result' | 'dispatch',
137	  ): Promise<string | undefined> {
138	    if (sessionId === undefined) {
139	      ctx.logger.warn(`spill-policy: no session owner for ${toolName} ${label}; keeping the inline content`)
140	      return undefined
141	    }
142	    const spillStore = ctx.get('spillStore')
143	    if (!spillStore) {
144	      ctx.logger.warn('spill-policy: no ctx.spillStore backend loaded; keeping the inline content')
145	      return undefined
146	    }
147	    const save: SaveTextSpill = {
148	      owner: { sessionId },
149	      source: { toolName, callId, label },
150	      suggestedName: `${toolName}.txt`,
151	      content: text,
152	    }
153	    let ref: SpillRef
154	    try {
155	      ref = await spillStore.saveText(save)
156	    } catch (error: unknown) {
157	      // Best-effort: a storage failure (permissions, ENOSPC, backend down) must
158	      // never fail the call or hide the content — keep the original inline.
159	      ctx.logger.warn(`spill-policy: saveText failed for ${toolName}: ${String(error)}; keeping the inline content`)
160	      return undefined
161	    }
162	
163	    // Reserve the notice's byte cost INSIDE maxInlineBytes so the replacement
164	    // (preview + blank line + notice) never exceeds the documented cap — a naive
165	    // preview that spent the whole budget then appended the notice could be
166	    // larger than the cap, and for a marginally-over result even larger than the
167	    // original. The reservation uses a notice priced at the worst-case omission
168	    // count (the full byte total): its digit count bounds the real count's, so
169	    // the reserved size is a safe upper bound and the final notice is never
170	    // longer than what we reserved. `\n\n` is the 2-byte join.
171	    const reserve = Buffer.byteLength(spillNotice({ kind: 'exact', count: totalBytes }, ref), 'utf8') + 2
172	    const previewBudget = Math.max(0, cap - reserve)
173	    const { text: previewText, omitted } = preview(text, previewBudget)
174	    const notice = spillNotice(omitted, ref)
175	    const replacedText = previewText.length > 0 ? `${previewText}\n\n${notice}` : notice
176	    // Invariant: the policy NEVER emits a replacement larger than the cap. When
177	    // the notice alone exceeds maxInlineBytes (a tiny cap or a long spill root),
178	    // there is no within-cap replacement, so keep the inline content — spilling
179	    // would break the advertised cap. (A within-cap replacement is always
180	    // smaller than the original, which is > cap by the entry condition, so this
181	    // one check subsumes "not smaller than the original" too. The spill file
182	    // already written is a harmless orphan; cleanup is deferred.)
183	    if (Buffer.byteLength(replacedText, 'utf8') > cap) {
184	      ctx.logger.warn(`spill-policy: spill notice for ${toolName} exceeds maxInlineBytes; keeping the inline content`)
185	      return undefined
186	    }
187	    return replacedText
188	  }
189	
190	  ctx.on('tools/post-execute', async (exec, result, next): Promise<PostToolDecision> => {
191	    // Delegate first so a downstream listener (e.g. a hook) settles the result;
192	    // we bound whatever it accepted. A block passes through — spill only shapes
193	    // accepted plain-text results, never corrective feedback.
194	    const decision = await next()
195	    // Skip `read` to avoid a read → spill → read again loop.
196	    if (decision.kind !== 'accept' || Object.hasOwn(decision, 'value')
197	      || exec.parent !== undefined || exec.name === 'read') return decision
198	
199	    const content = decision.content ?? result.content
200	    const text = flattenPlainText(content)
201	    if (text === undefined) return decision
202	    const totalBytes = Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8')
203	    if (totalBytes <= maxInlineBytes) return decision
204	
205	    const replacedText = await spillReplacement(text, totalBytes, ownerSessionId(exec), exec.name, exec.callId, 'result')
206	    if (replacedText === undefined) return decision
207	    const replaced: ContentBlock[] = [{ type: 'text', text: replacedText }]
208	    return { kind: 'accept', content: replaced, ...decision.additionalContexts ? { additionalContexts: decision.additionalContexts } : {} }
209	  }, { prepend: true })
210	
211	  // The durable-log arm: bound the `tool/code-dispatch` event's copy of an
212	  // oversized sub-call result the same way the model-facing arm bounds an
213	  // outer result. The program's returned value is untouched (it already
214	  // crossed the worker boundary whole); only the session log's copy shrinks
215	  // to preview + locator, so replay and UIs read the full text through the
216	  // spill artifact exactly as they do for spilled native results.
217	  ctx.on('tools/ptc-dispatch-log', async (dispatch, next): Promise<ContentBlock[]> => {
218	    const content = await next()
219	    // `read` sub-calls spill too: the log copy is not model context, so the
220	    // read → spill → read-again loop the post-execute arm avoids cannot
221	    // happen here, and read is precisely the tool that produces huge logs.
222	    const text = flattenPlainText(content)
223	    if (text === undefined) return content
224	    const totalBytes = Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8')
225	    if (totalBytes <= maxInlineBytes) return content
226	
227	    const replacedText = await spillReplacement(
228	      text, totalBytes, ownerSessionId(dispatch.exec), dispatch.name, dispatch.subCallId, 'dispatch')
229	    if (replacedText === undefined) return content
230	    return [{ type: 'text', text: replacedText }]
231	  }, { prepend: true })
232	}

1	import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
2	import { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
3	import { ToolCallId , createMessage, createToolResultMessage } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
4	import type { ContentBlock } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
5	import SessionStore, {
6	  Session,
7	  SessionId,
8	} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
9	import type { SurfaceEvent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
10	import * as SessionInvariant from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/invariant'
11	import InvariantRegistry from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants'
12	import SessionProjectionRegistry from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection'
13	import TokenMeter from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter'
14	import ToolResultPruner, {
15	  codePointLength,
16	  DEFAULTS,
17	  PRUNE_MARKER,
18	  resolveConfig,
19	} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
20	import type { ToolResultPruneConfig } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
21	
22	const MODEL = 'test-model'
23	const SMALL: ToolResultPruneConfig = {
24	  thresholdChars: 50,
25	  headChars: 4,
26	  tailChars: 3,
27	}
28	
29	function service(config: ToolResultPruneConfig = SMALL): ToolResultPruner {
30	  const ctx = new Context()
31	  // Service constructors self-register, so `ctx.tokenMeter` resolves for the
32	  // shadow-price pricing without a full plugin boot.
33	  new SessionProjectionRegistry(ctx)
34	  void new TokenMeter(ctx)
35	  return new ToolResultPruner(ctx, config)
36	}
37	
38	/** Pricing oracle mirroring the service's estimator for expectations. */
39	const METER_CTX = new Context()
40	new SessionProjectionRegistry(METER_CTX)
41	const METER = new TokenMeter(METER_CTX)
42	
43	function appendToolStep(
44	  session: Session,
45	  turn: number,
46	  call: string,
47	  content: ContentBlock[],
48	  extra: Record<string, unknown> = {},
49	): number {
50	  const callId = ToolCallId(call)
51	  session.append('turn/start', {
52	    turn,
53	  })
54	  session.append('step/start', { turn, step: 1 })
55	  session.append('assistant/message', {
56	    turn,
57	    step: 1,
58	    message: createMessage({
59	      role: 'assistant',
60	      content: [{ type: 'tool-call', id: callId, name: 'bash', arguments: '{}' }],
61	      source: {
62	        kind: 'model',
63	        ...{ provider: MODEL, model: MODEL },
64	      },
65	    }),
66	  }, { surfaceOp: 'append' })
67	  session.append('tool/call', { turn, step: 1, callId, name: 'bash', arguments: '{}' })
68	  const result = session.append('tool/result', {
69	    turn,
70	    step: 1,
71	    message: createToolResultMessage({ callId, content, isError: false }),
72	    ...extra,
73	  }, { surfaceOp: 'append' })
74	  session.append('step/end', { turn, step: 1 })
75	  session.append('turn/end', { turn, reason: { kind: 'completed' } })
76	  return result.seq
77	}
78	
79	describe('tool-result pruning configuration', () => {
80	  it('resolves detached immutable defaults and partial overrides', () => {
81	    const raw = { thresholdChars: 100, headChars: 20, tailChars: 10 }
82	    const resolved = resolveConfig(raw)
83	    raw.headChars = 1
84	    expect(resolved).toEqual({ thresholdChars: 100, headChars: 20, tailChars: 10 })
85	    expect(Object.isFrozen(resolved)).toBe(true)
86	    expect(DEFAULTS).toEqual({ thresholdChars: 8192, headChars: 4096, tailChars: 1024 })
87	    expect(Object.isFrozen(DEFAULTS)).toBe(true)
88	  })
89	
90	  it('rejects stale keys, invalid scalars, and an output budget above threshold', () => {
91	    const bad = [
92	      [{ thresholdChars: 0 }, /thresholdChars .* positive integer/],
93	      [{ headChars: -1 }, /headChars .* non-negative integer/],
94	      [{ tailChars: 1.5 }, /tailChars .* non-negative integer/],
95	      [{ thresholdChars: 50, headChars: 20, tailChars: 20 }, /headChars \+ marker \+ tailChars/],
96	      [{ threshold: 10 }, /unknown key "threshold"/],
97	    ] as Array<[unknown, RegExp]>
98	    for (const [config, pattern] of bad) {
99	      expect(() => resolveConfig(config as ToolResultPruneConfig)).toThrow(pattern)
100	    }
101	  })
102	})
103	
104	describe('ToolResultPruner content transform', () => {
105	  it('measures text code points only and skips content within threshold', () => {
106	    const prune = service()
107	    const blocks = [
108	      { type: 'text', text: 'a😀b' },
109	      { type: 'reasoning', text: 'not measured' },
110	    ] satisfies ContentBlock[]
111	    expect(prune.measureContent(blocks)).toBe(3)
112	    expect(prune.pruneContent(blocks)).toBeNull()
113	    expect(codePointLength('a😀b')).toBe(3)
114	  })
115	
116	  it('keeps configured head and tail without splitting surrogate pairs', () => {
117	    const prune = service()
118	    const result = prune.pruneContent([{ type: 'text', text: '😀'.repeat(60) }])
119	    expect(result).toEqual([{
120	      type: 'text',
121	      text: `${'😀'.repeat(4)}${PRUNE_MARKER}${'😀'.repeat(3)}`,
122	    }])
123	    expect(prune.measureContent(result!)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(50)
124	    expect(result![0]).toMatchObject({ type: 'text' })
125	    expect((result![0] as { text: string }).text).not.toContain('\uFFFD')
126	  })
127	
128	  it('preserves non-text blocks and their relative ordering across removed text', () => {
129	    const prune = service()
130	    const reasoning: ContentBlock = { type: 'reasoning', text: 'private-rich-block' }
131	    const call: ContentBlock = {
132	      type: 'tool-call',
133	      id: ToolCallId('nested'),
134	      name: 'nested',
135	      arguments: '{}',
136	    }
137	    const result = prune.pruneContent([
138	      { type: 'text', text: 'A'.repeat(40) },
139	      reasoning,
140	      { type: 'text', text: 'B'.repeat(30) },
141	      call,
142	      { type: 'text', text: 'C'.repeat(30) },
143	    ])
144	    expect(result).toEqual([
145	      { type: 'text', text: `AAAA${PRUNE_MARKER}` },
146	      reasoning,
147	      call,
148	      { type: 'text', text: 'CCC' },
149	    ])
150	    expect(prune.measureContent(result!)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(50)
151	  })
152	
153	  it('supports zero-sized head and tail while still shrinking', () => {
154	    const prune = service({
155	      thresholdChars: codePointLength(PRUNE_MARKER),
156	      headChars: 0,
157	      tailChars: 0,
158	    })
159	    const result = prune.pruneContent([{ type: 'text', text: 'x'.repeat(100) }])
160	    expect(result).toEqual([{ type: 'text', text: PRUNE_MARKER }])
161	    expect(prune.measureContent(result!)).toBe(prune.config.thresholdChars)
162	  })
163	})
164	
165	describe('ToolResultPruner session transaction', () => {
166	  it('prunes a stable snapshot, preserves all data, and cites the replaced result', () => {
167	    const session = Session.create(SessionId('preserve'))
168	    const originalSeq = appendToolStep(session, 1, 'one', [{
169	      type: 'text',
170	      text: 'x'.repeat(100),
171	    }], {
172	      isError: true,
173	      error: { name: 'ExitError', code: 'EXIT_1' },
174	      meta: { diff: ['a', 'b'] },
175	      futureField: { nested: true },
176	    })
177	    session.append('turn/start', {
178	      turn: 2,
179	    })
180	
181	    const result = service().pruneSession(session)
182	    expect(result.pruned).toHaveLength(1)
183	    expect(result.charsRemoved).toBeGreaterThan(0)
184	    const entry = result.pruned[0]!
185	    expect(entry).toMatchObject({ originalSeq, callId: ToolCallId('one'), charsBefore: 100 })
186	    expect(entry.charsAfter).toBeLessThanOrEqual(50)
187	
188	    const original = session.events[originalSeq]!
189	    const replacement = session.events[entry.replacementSeq]! as SurfaceEvent
190	    expect(original).toMatchObject({
191	      type: 'tool/result',
192	      data: {
193	        message: {
194	          content: [{
195	            type: 'tool-result',
196	            content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'x'.repeat(100) }],
197	          }],
198	        },
199	      },
200	    })
201	    expect(replacement).toMatchObject({
202	      type: 'tool/result',
203	      data: {
204	        turn: 1,
205	        step: 1,
206	        isError: true,
207	        message: {
208	          source: { kind: 'tool', callId: ToolCallId('one') },
209	        },
210	        error: { name: 'ExitError', code: 'EXIT_1' },
211	        meta: { diff: ['a', 'b'] },
212	        futureField: { nested: true },
213	      },
214	      surfaceOp: { op: 'replace', start: originalSeq, end: originalSeq },
215	      sourceEventSeqs: [originalSeq],
216	    })
217	    expect(session.surface.nodes).not.toContain(originalSeq)
218	
219	    // Shadow-price protocol: the metering event sits directly before the
220	    // replacement and prices the shadowed node with the shared estimator.
221	    if (original.type !== 'tool/result') throw new Error('original is not a tool/result')
222	    expect(session.events[entry.replacementSeq - 1]).toMatchObject({
223	      type: 'compaction/prune',
224	      data: {
225	        shadowedRange: { start: originalSeq, end: originalSeq },
226	        shadowedSeqs: [originalSeq],
227	        shadowedTokenCount: METER.estimateMessage(original.data.message),
228	      },
229	    })
230	  })
231	
232	  it('prunes multiple results, skips short ones, and converges in one pass', () => {
233	    const session = Session.create(SessionId('multiple'))
234	    appendToolStep(session, 1, 'a', [{ type: 'text', text: 'A'.repeat(100) }])
235	    appendToolStep(session, 2, 'b', [{ type: 'text', text: 'short' }])
236	    appendToolStep(session, 3, 'c', [{ type: 'text', text: 'C'.repeat(80) }])
237	    session.append('turn/start', {
238	      turn: 4,
239	    })
240	    const prune = service()
241	    const first = prune.pruneSession(session)
242	    const second = prune.pruneSession(session)
243	    expect(first.pruned.map(entry => entry.callId)).toEqual([ToolCallId('a'), ToolCallId('c')])
244	    expect(first.charsRemoved).toBe(
245	      first.pruned.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.charsBefore - entry.charsAfter, 0),
246	    )
247	    expect(second).toEqual({ pruned: [], charsRemoved: 0 })
248	  })
249	
250	  it('replays to the identical pruned model messages', () => {
251	    const session = Session.create(SessionId('replay'))
252	    appendToolStep(session, 1, 'a', [{ type: 'text', text: 'A'.repeat(100) }])
253	    session.append('turn/start', {
254	      turn: 2,
255	    })
256	    service().pruneSession(session)
257	    const replay = Session.create(session.id, [...session.events])
258	    expect(replay.deriveMessages()).toEqual(session.deriveMessages())
259	    expect(replay.surface.replaceGeneration).toBe(session.surface.replaceGeneration)
260	  })
261	
262	  it('runs under real invariants between closed steps but not outside a turn', async () => {
263	    const ctx = new Context()
264	    await ctx.plugin(SessionStore)
265	    await ctx.plugin(SessionProjectionRegistry)
266	    await ctx.plugin(InvariantRegistry)
267	    await ctx.plugin(SessionInvariant)
268	    await ctx.plugin(TokenMeter)
269	    const prune = new ToolResultPruner(ctx, SMALL)
270	    const session = ctx.sessions.create(SessionId('invariants'))
271	    appendToolStep(session, 1, 'a', [{ type: 'text', text: 'A'.repeat(100) }])
272	    expect(() => prune.pruneSession(session)).toThrow(/outside any open turn/)
273	    session.append('turn/start', {
274	      turn: 2,
275	    })
276	    expect(() => prune.pruneSession(session)).not.toThrow()
277	  })
278	})
